reason: This is not a routine dependency bump: it appears to enable a new async batch-get behavior in the TiKV client and wire it through production store paths plus mockstore/unistore. Changes in `pkg/store/copr`, `pkg/store/driver`, and mock RPC redirection can affect KV read-path correctness, request ordering/error handling, fallback behavior, and executor-visible semantics. That is central enough in the storage/runtime stack to justify a focused Blocker/High review.
